nome_jp: 希望の覇王 鬼丸 「刀」
testo:
■ Evolution—Put on one of your Hunters.
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, destroy any number of your opponent's creatures that have total power 13000 or less.
■ When this creature is destroyed, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
